title: tools: optimize use of regexes
description:
Python's re module allows to precompile expressions so they can be
reused. This change modifies the regex so they're no longer recompiled
for every test but instead precompiled when the script runs. The
improvement is likely not noticable by a human but given that this
script is executed for every commit made, the savings will accumulate
over time.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2

-PACKET_SOURCE_FILE_PATTERN = r'^(data|packet)-.*\.c$'

-PACKET_HEADER_FILE_PATTERN = r'^(data|file|packet)-.*\.h$'

+PACKET_HEADER_FILE_PATTERN = re.compile(r'^(data|file|packet)-.*\.h$')
+PUBLIC_HEADER_PATTERN = re.compile(r'(^\s*WS_DLL_PUBLIC\b|\bstruct\s.*tap_|\bPUBLIC_HEADER\b)', re.MULTILINE)
+PACKET_HEADER_INCLUDE_PATTERN = re.compile(r'^\s*#\s*include\s.*\b(packet-.*\.h)\b', re.MULTILINE)
+
+CMAKE_SET_PUBLIC_HEADER_PATTERN = re.compile(r'^\s*set\s*\(\s*DISSECTOR_PUBLIC_HEADERS')
